snippet.title: C64 Longplay: Beyond the Forbidden Forest
snippet.description:
In Shotcut, I added a Reverb audio filter, a Glow video filter for the later scenes, and played the game through using Render filter Scalex2 in WinVice to take the blockiness off a bit. Even though the attack patterns simply repeat themselves throughout (Crab, Worm, Dragonfly, Toad), this video shows the gradual shift from day to night, including the storm scenes.

TIMELINE:
0:00 Intros
1:36 Gameplay (forest)
27:16 Bug where I got killed but instead of dying got an arrow
28:14 Last part (cave)
30:30 Weird bug and death scenes
